query:
SELECT id AS "id!: i64", name,
                  date AS "date?: String",
                  created_by_id AS "created_by_id!: i64",
                  created_at AS "created_at!: NaiveDateTime"
           FROM competitions
           ORDER BY CASE WHEN date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                    date ASC,
                    created_at DESC
